title: Require Service Proof Isolation
forbids: standalone service production source that imports, re-exports, dynamically imports, requires, or resolves a relative module source containing an exact test path segment
why: Package-root proof may consume production behavior, but production source must not acquire proof fixtures, harnesses, support, or suites.
remediate: Move proof-only code under the package-root test categories and remove the production-to-proof edge. Do not replace it with a proof alias.
message: Service production source must not import package proof code.
